g.text: Scope hierarchy semantics: entry, regions, history, completion
entry / run entry activities (sequential observed effects)
exit / snapshot history, then run exit activities
Regions are a modeling view. The kernel realizes
orthogonality as multiple tokens in one flat scope
token-count exhaustion, not per-region final states.
History captures the key set of the active configuration
After the first completion of a history-declaring
scope, plain re-entry also restores the remembered
configuration (no history node required, no mode
filter): the initial pseudostate becomes a default
